verified.analysis: Verified from the 2026-10-02 8-K: the merger agreement is unchanged at $16 cash. The original HSR clearance lapsed after 2026-10-06, and a new filing on 2026-10-02 started a 30-day wait. The DFPI suspended its approval on 2026-08-14 "pending further review", and the parties said they did not expect reinstatement before 2026-10-06. Closing now requires both DFPI reinstatement and HSR expiry. The stock trades at $9.75 (+6.4% on the day, near the 52w low of $8.32, against a 200d average of $14.23), which prices a likely break, not a coin-flip. The contractual numerator is exempt from provenance re-derivation; June-30 10-Q shows cash $150.6M vs debt $113.8M, so standalone downside is cushioned, not zero. Gaps (web-search budget was exhausted, so these were not checked): why the DFPI suspended its approval (possibly compliance/AML), the outside date and extension mechanics, the termination and reverse-termination fees, and whether HSR expired or got early termination on ~Nov-1. Kept at WATCH because the gating approval is undated and the outside date is unknown. Upgrade to ACTIVE on a DFPI reinstatement filing or a confirmed outside date that leaves time.

verified.primary_source: Inhibrx PR 'FDA Acceptance of BLA for Ozekibart' (PRNewswire, 2026-06-15); Inhibrx PR 'Amended Loan Agreement with Oxford Finance, $500M facility' (2026-07-16); Inhibrx PR conference schedule incl. verified.analysis: The PDUFA date of 2027-04-14 checks out against the company's own BLA-acceptance PR (2026-06-15, no filing review issues). The debt risk flagged in triage is real. Oxford expanded the facility to $500M on 2026-07-16 and funded $100M (Term C) on signing. That puts senior secured debt at about $275M+ (the Q2 balance sheet already carried ~$176M of non-current liabilities) against Q2 cash of $133M, plus the $100M, which is about $233M pro forma. Burn is about $28M+ per quarter, book equity is -$53M, and the further $225M Term D is at the lenders' sole discretion. So the equity sits behind a growing secured stack, and a CRL would likely mean a dilutive raise. One gap I could not close: a -23% drop on 2026-10-28 (from $95.66 to $73.29 on about 4x normal volume) came the day before the MSTS secondary-endpoints oral, and no press release explains it. It may have been a negative OS/secondary-endpoint signal, and that needs checking before CTOS. The web-search budget was exhausted, so the 10-Q covenant and milestone terms on the Oxford tranches were also not checked. Insider buying in Sep 2026 (CEO $2.6M at ~$106, director $1M at $100) and ~28% short interest are supportive, but those buys are now underwater. The score holds at 5 WATCH until the cause of the 10-28 drop and the CTOS PFS update are known.

verified.analysis: The event is real and still ahead: a committed spin of EMEA via an LSE listing runs in parallel with a possible PE sale. But there are no named counterparties, no deadline and no price beyond an FT estimate below $6B, and the business has just taken a $1.38B goodwill impairment. The market has already added +15.5% since 10/14, and a rough SoP check does not support material upside above $36.83. Upgrade only on a signed sale with a stated price and use of proceeds, or a dated spin record date. Gaps: web search was exhausted and the 10-Q was not read, so net debt (~$10B) and the EMEA debt allocation are estimates.

Value has not been harvested: KBR trades about 28% below its pre-announcement price, so the market is not pricing a big spin premium. But the parts value is my own estimate and only about 15-25% above today's price. Gap in numerator provenance: the web search budget was used up, so I could not pull the latest 10-Q to check net debt, how debt will be split between KBR and Trinzic, or any leakage to the common from preferreds or pensions. I know of no preferred stock at KBR, but under the provenance rule I score the equity, not the event, and cap at 4. Keep as WATCH and re-score in mid-December, once the Form 10 shows the debt split and when-issued prices exist. The better entry is likely Trinzic during post-spin forced selling in Jan-Feb 2027, not KBR now.
